input_fields: data snapshot hash and availability clock
failure_rules: Do not convert missing eventType or a normal return into delivery success.
Reject unknown custom-facet versions and unresolved artifact identities.
Retain durable local record and explicit receiver acknowledgement/persistence contract.
Reconcile retries/duplicate/reordered events; UUID alone is not idempotency.
Timeout/cancel/requested deadline and causal refusal remain separate.
Record debug/logging and access policy without sending sensitive artifacts indiscriminately.
native_delivery_oracle: Not established; registered generated receiver/fault trials required.
